test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

A person who is interested in material gains and is hostile to art/culture
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**' i.e**. 'Philistine'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word that can substitute the given group of words is:** "Philistine"**
 
• A **"Philistine" **is a term used to describe a person who is indifferent or hostile to artistic and cultural values;(प्रागधिकारवादी)
 
• It** also refers** to a person whose interests are primarily material and conventional.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Philistine'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the other options:
 
 
• **"Perfectionist" **- This refers to a person who refuses to accept any standard short of perfection, in their own work and/or in other aspects of life.(पूर्णतावादी)
 
• **"Sage" -** A sage is a profoundly wise person, particularly one who features in ancient history or legend.(ज्ञानी)
 
• **"Egghead" **- An "Egghead" is an intellectual or a very studious and academic person. It's often used informally or humorously.(बुद्धिजीवी)
 
 

46:Ta9c,

The correct answer is 'Option 1'
